decision: Do not merge nine-entry indexed Set promotion. Large string lookups improve, but small numeric lookups and full native compiler execution regress. No full candidate gate queued. Continue generic capture allocation and root/register overhead work.

inputs.scope: Same client/harness/resource settings and one sealed baseline Node compiler host. Before and after source graphs differ only in the ordered set/hash helper implementation. Matched native compiler workloads compile the same after source using baseline and candidate native compilers built from their respective frozen sources.

operation.scope: Bespoke same-source operation benchmark; not Test262 coverage. proc_pid_rusage V4 instruction/cycle and user/system CPU counters converted through mach_timebase_info, sampled every 1 ms between initial stop and final exit. CPU is a lower bound; the final unobserved wall interval bounds missing CPU. Monotonic inferior-wall includes debugger resume/exit handling and excludes launch.

selfbuild.scope: One full native compiler execution per generated representation; same exact TypeScript source and identical emitted compiler bytes. Operation benchmarks provide repeated CPU medians. Both stage-1 images were built by the same frozen Node compiler host from their respective source snapshots; the native workloads compile the identical after snapshot. Workspace and native fixture gates remain required.

cardinality.scope: Diagnostic Node execution of the exact portable compiler source/algorithm. Built-in Set is a transparent subclass for operation/cardinality counts. It does not time native execution or establish native outcomes. This histogram guides runtime representation thresholds only.
